slice: Suzuki 2017 RM-Z250 and 2022 RM85 wiring (wiring pass 2026-11)

records.topic: Harness wire colours at every component
records.statement: Main-harness wire colours at each plug on the 2017 RM-Z250. Magneto: yellow, yellow (charging) plus green/white and blue (pickup). Regulator/rectifier: yellow, yellow, red, black/white. Condenser: red and black/white. Fuel pump: red/black and red. Injector: gray/white and red. Ignition coil: white/blue and black/white. Engine stop switch: black/yellow and black/white. Throttle position sensor: red/blue, yellow, black/brown. Intake air pressure sensor: red/blue, green/black, black/brown. Intake air temperature sensor: dark green and black/brown. Coolant temperature sensor: black/blue and black/brown. Tip-over sensor: red/blue, brown/white, black/brown. Gear position switch: blue/black, pink, black/white. S-HAC (launch) switch: red, blue/red, white/red, black/white. Optional battery lead: red and black/white. Red/blue is common to the throttle, intake pressure and tip-over sensors, black/brown is the shared sensor return, and black/white is the frame ground. Some parts have a short pigtail in different colours, so read the harness side of the plug. Suzuki's letters: B black, Bl blue, Br brown, Dg dark green, G green, Gr gray, Lg light green, O orange, P pink, R red, W white, Y yellow.

source.name: Suzuki RM-Z250 2017 owner's service manual, wiring diagram page 5-9

records.notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

records.statement: The 2022 RM85 has no battery and one small circuit. The magneto feeds the CDI unit on three wires: black/red, red/white and black/white. The CDI fires the ignition coil on white/blue, and black/white is the ground shared by the CDI and the coil. The engine stop switch is on black/yellow from the CDI and grounds it to the frame when pressed. Suzuki's colour code: B/W black with white tracer, B/R black with red tracer, R/W red with white tracer, B/Y black with yellow tracer, W/Bl white with blue tracer.

source.name: Suzuki RM85 2022 owner's service manual, electrical circuit page 13-2
